name: hyva-themes/magento2-inventory-order-reservation
description: Gives an order created through Magento's order API the stock side of a placed order: the Inventory reservation, or the legacy stock deduction, on request, with recovery and a coordinated repair path.

suggest.magento/module-inventory-sales: With Magento Inventory the module places the order's reservation; without it, it deducts the legacy stock item.
